A glint of brass catches the light near the base of the tree, half-buried in the moss. The wood feels older than the market you just left, as if time itself has slowed here.
answer.summary: Iri Calder enters Rook Wood for the first time, noticing Maren Vosk under the old tree and a brass key lying nearby.
